metadata.task_name: Angular Template Binding and XSS Surface Review

execution.coverage: ~90% — all HTML templates and key TypeScript components reviewed; some utility function bodies (GXUtils) partially reviewed

finding.preliminary_assessment: Angular template binding review found the application correctly uses {{ }} interpolation (with built-in HTML encoding) for rendering server-supplied field content across all transformation component templates (text, menu, table, calendar, clickable). However, the print and copy functionality in AppComponent bypasses Angular's sanitization in two places: (1) formatPrintPage() at line 533-535 uses document.write() with unsanitized screen line content concatenated into HTML — if any screen line contains HTML-like characters from the host terminal data (e.g., '<', '>', '"', or fully formed HTML tags), they will be interpreted as HTML in the popup window; (2) formatCopyPage() at line 560 reads divElement.innerHTML and stores it as copyData, which is then written to copyDiv.innerHTML in modalpopup.component.ts line 61. The DomSanitizer is imported and injected in AppComponent but never used — indicating incomplete sanitization implementation.

patterns_observed: All transformation templates (text, menu, table, calendar, clickable) correctly use {{ }} interpolation — safe
Host key labels in host-keys-template use {{ hostKey.caption }} — safe
All [ngStyle] bindings use numeric grid position primitives — safe
DomSanitizer injected in AppComponent constructor but never used — incomplete sanitization
Print popup: document.write() with unsanitized server content concatenation
Copy modal: innerHTML chain from divElement.innerHTML → copyData → copyDiv.innerHTML
modalpopup.component.ts line 117: innerHTML assignment with getSelection() text: '' + element + ''

false_positives.rationale: Angular's [ngStyle] directive sanitizes CSS values; bindings use numeric primitives only
showToast() is completely commented out (disabled); risk only exists if re-enabled
Generated page components use field/text components with safe {{ }} interpolation, not direct innerHTML

analysis.coverage_assessment: 20+ HTML template files reviewed; 30+ TypeScript component files checked for bypassSecurityTrust*, innerHTML, outerHTML, and DomSanitizer usage. Complete for key risk areas.

for_inquisitor: Verify GXUtils.formatLineText() output — does it return plaintext or could it produce HTML markup from host screen data?
Test: inject terminal screen data containing '' — does it execute in the print popup window?
Verify whether modalpopup copyDiv innerHTML content is ever displayed to other users or only the current user
Assess whether the print popup window has a CSP that would block inline scripts
Confirm scope: is XSS confined to the current user's session or could it affect other users?
